title: How 1,100 Artists Fooled An Entire Army 🎨
world: Northern France and the Rhine river area, 1944-1945, Second World War. American soldiers are 1944 US Army GIs in olive-drab uniforms and M1 helmets with period US Army equipment; French villagers wear 1940s rural clothing; German soldiers appear only from behind or in silhouette in plain field-grey uniforms with NO insignia, badges or symbols. 1940s vehicles, farmland, hedgerows and stone villages. Nothing modern.
look: Clean vivid colours, clear air, no dust haze, crisp outlines against simple uncluttered backgrounds, theatrical exaggerated body language.

C1.name: The artist GI (hero)
C1.kit: a 24-year-old American WWII army private and former art student, slim build, fair skin with light freckles, short wavy chestnut-brown hair, clean-shaven, friendly narrow face; olive-drab M1 steel helmet with the chin strap hanging loose, olive-drab M-1941 field jacket with a small brick-red paint smear on the right sleeve, a brick-red knitted scarf tucked in at the collar, khaki wool trousers, brown leather lace-up boots. Signature colours: olive drab and brick red

C2.name: The two French boys
C2.kit: two French village boys aged about 11: the taller boy wears a navy-blue flat cap, a navy wool jacket, short grey trousers and knee socks; the smaller boy has messy blond hair, a mustard-yellow knitted sweater and brown shorts; both wear worn leather shoes and ride old black bicycles. Signature colours: navy blue and mustard yellow

round2.desc: C1_REF and three other American GIs in the same olive-drab uniform stand in a row in an open green field and casually lift a full-size Sherman tank above their heads with their bare hands, arms straight up, the tank perfectly balanced on their palms. It is secretly a rubber inflatable tank, but it must look like a real heavy olive-drab tank. C1_REF is second from the left.
round2.camera: low angle, wide shot, whole tank and all four men from head to boots
round2.light: bright clear morning sun from the right, blue sky

round2.desc: C1_REF alone, waist up, holding the front edge of an olive-drab tank hull above his head with both hands, elbows bent, standing tall and relaxed, a clear blue sky behind him.
round2.camera: low angle medium shot, waist up
round2.light: bright clear morning sun from the right, blue sky

round2.desc: two bare hands of an American GI in olive-drab sleeves, palms up, holding the underside of an olive-drab tank hull; the hull's surface shows a faint rubbery sheen and a small brass air valve
round2.light: bright clear morning sun from the right, blue sky

round2.desc: C2_REF: the two French boys on their bicycles on a narrow dirt country road between hedgerows, both feet down, stopped side by side and looking toward the right of the frame.
round2.camera: eye level, medium-long shot, both boys full body with their bicycles
round2.light: bright clear morning sun from the right, blue sky

round2.desc: Over-the-shoulder view from behind the two French boys of C2_REF on their bicycles (backs of their heads and shoulders in the foreground, left edge), looking across a field at four American GIs in the distance holding a Sherman tank above their heads.
round2.camera: eye level, over-the-shoulder from behind the boys, deep focus
round2.light: bright clear morning sun from the right, blue sky

round2.desc: A German officer seen only from behind, in a plain field-grey greatcoat and cap with no insignia, standing on a ridge and looking through binoculars across a wide valley toward a distant line of tanks.
round2.camera: eye level, back view, medium shot, the man on the left third, valley on the right
round2.light: cold overcast light, grey-blue sky

round2.desc: Hundreds of American GIs in olive-drab uniforms and helmets standing in neat rows in a huge open field, seen from far above; at the front centre stands C1_REF.
round2.camera: high aerial wide shot, deep focus
round2.light: warm golden late-afternoon sun from the left, soft fill

round2.desc: A wide French countryside landscape in 1944: patchwork farm fields, hedgerows, a stone village with a church steeple, and a small US Army jeep driving along a dirt road with C1_REF in the passenger seat.
round2.camera: high wide establishing shot, deep focus
round2.light: warm golden late-afternoon sun from the left, soft fill

round2.desc: Inside a canvas army command tent, three American officers in 1944 uniforms lean over a big paper map of France on a wooden table, one pointing, lit by a hanging lantern.
round2.light: warm lantern light from above, cool daylight from the tent door

round2.desc: C1_REF stands at a wooden easel in a farmhouse barn turned into an art studio, holding a paintbrush and a palette, painting a big camouflage pattern of green and brown blobs on canvas; paint pots and stencils around.
round2.camera: eye level, medium-long shot, full body
round2.light: warm sunlight through a barn door from the left

round2.desc: C1_REF wearing big 1940s headphones sits at a large wooden disc-recording machine with a microphone on a stand; beside him a second GI holding a script reads lines dramatically with one arm raised like a stage actor.
round2.light: warm desk lamp light, dark wooden room

round2.desc: C1_REF stands in front of a small group of GIs on a misty field at dawn, chin up, hands on hips, the men behind him half lost in pale mist like ghosts.
round2.light: cold pale dawn light, mist

round2.desc: C1_REF, from the chest up, leans slightly toward the camera with both hands hidden behind his back as if hiding a surprise, head tilted, looking straight into the lens.
round2.light: warm golden late-afternoon sun from the left, soft fill

round2.desc: a GI's hand squeezing and denting the soft olive-drab rubber skin of an inflatable tank, the rubber creased under his fingers
round2.light: bright clear morning sun from the right, blue sky

round2.desc: A row of olive-drab inflatable dummy Sherman tanks, a truck and an artillery cannon standing in an open field, some still half-inflated and sagging; C1_REF in the foreground works a hand air pump connected by a hose.
round2.light: warm golden late-afternoon sun from the left, soft fill

round2.desc: At night in an empty field, C1_REF pumps a long-handled air pump with both arms; behind him a flat, sagging rubber tank lies on the grass, half inflated.
round2.camera: eye level, medium-long shot, full body
round2.light: cool blue moonlight from above-left, faint warm lantern glow from the right

round2.change: the rubber tank behind him is now fully inflated and looks like a real tank; C1_REF leans back against it with his arms crossed, one boot crossed over the other

round2.desc: Morning aerial view looking down from a small plane: the plain grey wingtip of the plane in the top-left corner (no markings), and below it a green field filled with long neat rows of hundreds of olive-drab tanks.
round2.camera: aerial view looking down from a plane, deep focus
round2.light: soft early-morning sun, long shadows

round2.desc: C1_REF, from the waist up, cups one hand behind his ear and leans to the side as if listening for something, eyebrows raised, a clear simple dark background.
round2.light: cool blue moonlight from above-left, faint warm lantern glow from the right

round2.desc: A 1944 US Army half-track truck at night with a huge loudspeaker horn array mounted on its back pointing across a dark field; C1_REF stands on the truck bed beside the speakers.
round2.light: cool blue moonlight from above-left, faint warm lantern glow from the right

round2.desc: Inside the back of an army truck at night, C1_REF wearing big headphones turns the knobs of a bulky 1940s sound control panel with spinning record discs, leaning in, excited.
round2.light: warm amber glow from the dials, cool moonlight outside

round2.desc: A German sentry seen only from behind, in a plain field-grey uniform and helmet with no insignia, standing in a dark pine forest at night and turning his head toward a distant glow on the horizon.
round2.camera: eye level, back view, medium-long shot
round2.light: cool blue moonlight from above-left, faint warm lantern glow from the right

round2.desc: a 1940s US Army field radio set with dials, a coiled cable, a pair of headphones and a brass Morse key on a wooden crate, a hand resting on the Morse key
round2.light: warm lamp light, dark surroundings

round2.desc: C1_REF sits at a wooden crate with a 1940s field radio, headphones on, tapping a Morse key with one finger and looking sideways at the camera, sly.
round2.light: warm lamp light, dark tent interior

round2.change: C1_REF now leans far back in his chair with both boots up on the crate and his hands behind his head, relaxed and smug

round2.desc: A small French village cafe terrace with little round tables; C1_REF and another GI sit at a table with glasses of wine while a French waiter in a white apron stands nearby with a tray.
round2.light: warm sunny afternoon light

round2.desc: hands sewing a plain round embroidered army shoulder patch (simple coloured circle design, no letters) onto the olive-drab sleeve of a field jacket with needle and thread
round2.light: warm lamp light

round2.change: C1_REF now leans far back in his chair, one arm flung out wide and the other hand held beside his mouth like he is announcing a secret loudly, while the waiter leans in to eavesdrop

round2.desc: C1_REF stands in a sunny field with a rubber Sherman tank behind him, shrugging dramatically, both palms up and shoulders raised, looking at the camera.
round2.camera: eye level, medium-long shot, full body
round2.light: bright clear morning sun from the right, blue sky

round2.change: C1_REF now flexes his right biceps proudly like a strongman, chest puffed out, chin up

round2.desc: C2_REF: the two French boys on their bicycles side by side, both nodding slowly, mouths closed, holding the handlebars.
round2.camera: eye level, medium shot from the waist up
round2.light: bright clear morning sun from the right, blue sky

round2.change: the smaller boy in the mustard sweater now leans back with his arms crossed and one eyebrow raised, unconvinced; the taller boy is unchanged

round2.desc: an old paper army map of northern France, Belgium and the Rhine river on a wooden table, hand-drawn with faded colours, rivers in blue, no readable text
round2.light: warm lamp light, soft shadows

round2.desc: C1_REF stands tiny next to an enormous inflatable tank that towers over him, puffing out his chest and standing on tiptoe to look bigger.
round2.camera: low angle, wide shot, full body
round2.light: warm golden late-afternoon sun from the left, soft fill

round2.desc: A wide river landscape in early spring at dawn: a broad grey river with cold mist on the water, bare trees on the flat banks, a ruined stone bridge in the distance. No people.
round2.light: cold blue dawn light

round2.desc: At night on a muddy riverbank, many American GIs crouch beside rows of wooden and canvas assault boats, ready to launch them.
round2.light: cool blue moonlight from above-left, faint warm lantern glow from the right

round2.desc: At night on a different stretch of riverbank, C1_REF stands pointing ahead with one arm like a general, directing a row of rubber tanks being rolled into place behind him.
round2.camera: low angle, medium-long shot, full body
round2.light: cool blue moonlight from above-left, faint warm lantern glow from the right

round2.desc: On a dark ridge at night, the silhouettes of big field artillery guns all point toward the left of the frame; silhouettes of soldiers stand beside them, no insignia.
round2.camera: eye level, wide shot, silhouettes against a deep blue sky
round2.light: deep blue night sky, faint moon rim light

round2.desc: A huge orange artillery flash lights up the night sky over a dark river, the sky glowing orange above the black treeline.
round2.light: bright orange flash against deep night

round2.desc: Dawn on a wide river: many small assault boats full of American GIs paddle across the misty water toward the far bank.
round2.light: cold blue-grey dawn light

round2.desc: A long floating pontoon bridge across a wide river with 1944 US Army trucks and jeeps driving over it.
round2.light: soft morning light

round2.desc: A long column of American GIs marching across a pontoon bridge toward the sunrise, rifles on shoulders.
round2.camera: low angle, wide shot, silhouettes against the sunrise
round2.light: golden sunrise backlight

round2.desc: a thick manila army file folder tied with string and sealed with a red wax seal, lying in a dusty cardboard archive box among other old files; no readable text
round2.light: dim cool archive light, a single shaft of light

round2.desc: Golden sunset over an open French field: C1_REF and three other GIs stand in a row holding a big inflatable rubber tank above their heads like a balloon, their figures dark against the sky.
round2.camera: eye level, very wide shot, the men small in the frame
round2.light: golden sunset backlight

scene_lines.S06: If anyone learns how they did it,
scene_lines.S09: The army needs a way to fool the Germans.
scene_lines.S17: each one light enough for four men to carry.
scene_lines.S18: At night, they pump up a whole division in an empty field.
scene_lines.S19: By morning, German planes count hundreds of tanks.
scene_lines.S23: You can hear them fifteen miles away.
scene_lines.S25: Fake operators send fake orders to fake units.
scene_lines.S27: Men sew on other units' badges,
scene_lines.S28: sit in cafés, and loudly spill the wrong secrets.
scene_lines.S36: One small army pretending to be big ones.
scene_lines.S39: The real army is about to cross.
scene_lines.S40: The ghosts set up miles away.
scene_lines.S45: Their guns point at the wrong river bank.
scene_lines.S51: The army keeps it secret for fifty years.
scene_lines.S52: The strongest Americans in France are holding balloons.
scene_lines.S53: And they save thousands of lives.
